title: Refactor JSON Resource References to Compose Repo ID System
description: All JSON files in .repo should use the repo id system for resource references. Convert goal paths like AI-OPTIMIZED-REPO/REPO-CLIENT to emoji-prefixed flat format like 🎯️aioptimizedrepo🎯️repoclient. Also convert contributor references and parent goal references. Update CLI code to handle the new format.
summary: Refactored all .repo JSON files to use repo ID system (emoji-prefixed flat IDs). Migration script converted 1498 references across all ticket.json and goal.json files. Updated Go CLI with MarshalJSON/UnmarshalJSON boundary conversion for Ticket and Goal structs, added goalPathToComposeID/composeIDToGoalPath/contributorGithubToComposeID/composeIDToContributorGithub conversion functions, fixed Goal.GetID() for hierarchical format. All 15 relevant tests pass including 7 new round-trip tests. Fixed pre-existing hhmmss compile error in logHook.
